terminal_install_prompt_body:
{terminal_name} ga-emepe ugbu a na-agba ọsọ {usoro}.

• Ọ bụrụ na agbanyụbeghị, gbanyụọ ngwaọrụ gị.
• Ọ bụrụ na ejikọrọ ya na USB, buru ụzọ kwupu ya.
{ndu]
• Jikọọ ngwaọrụ gị na kọmputa gị mgbe mpio {terminal_name} meghere.

Pịa OK ka ịmalite wee pụọ Updater CE.

sp_gui_install_prompt_title: Wụnye site na SP Flash Tool GUI
sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
Ngwa SP Flash GUI ga-emepe ugbu a site na ebugoro ngwa ngwa gị.

• Na SP Flash Tool, họrọ "Format All + Download" si dropdown igbe.
• Pịa bọtịnụ "Download".
• Hụ na agbanyụrụ ngwaọrụ gị wee kwụpụ.
{ndu]
• Jikọọ eriri USB na kọmputa gị mgbe ịpịrị Budata.

Pịa OK ka ịmalite SP Flash Tool wee pụọ Updater CE.

settings_old_rockbox_warn_body:
Mwepụta nke Rockbox-Y1 tupu 0.5 adabaghị na nkeji Y1 rere mgbe Machị 2026 nwere Innioasis OS 3.0.7 etinyegoro ya.

Ịkụnye ihe nrụnye ochie na ngwaọrụ ndị a ga-egbochi ịkwọ ụgbọ.

Ị ji n'aka na ịchọrọ igosi ụlọ Rockbox ochie?

Biko kwụpụ USB, gbanye wee buba n'ime Rockbox otu ugboro (ya mere ọ na-amalite folda sistemu .rockbox nke ime ya), wee jikọọ USB wee họrọ 'USB Storage Mode'.

Mgbe ejikọrọ, pịa Gaa n'ihu ịhọrọ nchekwa ọ bụla na ọkpụkpọ gị.

Ngwa SP Flash GUI ga-amalite ugbu a.

• Ọ bụrụ na agbanyụbeghị, gbanyụọ ngwaọrụ gị.

Mgbe ahụ jikọọ eriri USB ka ịmalite ịmị ọkụ.

settings_skip_install_donations_tip: Gosi nkọwa mmecha dị mfe na-arịọghị onyinye mgbe ọkụ gasịrị.
settings_cache_desc: Hichapụ ngwungwu firmware ebudatara na faịlụ ROM ewepụtara iji wepụta ohere diski. A na-echekwa akụkọ nwụnye gị na mmasị ncheta gị.

retry_guidance_intro: Njikọ USB na ọkpụkpọ gị akwụsịla ịzaghachi. Onye ọkpụkpọ gị chọrọ nrụpụta akwụkwọ ntuziaka tupu mbọ ọzọ enwee ike ịrụ ọrụ.
retry_guidance_step_1: 1. Wepu eriri USB na ọkpụkpọ gị.
retry_guidance_step_2: 2. Pịa bọtịnụ nrụpụta zoro ezo na ntụtụ, obere mpempe akwụkwọ ma ọ bụ ọla ntị.
retry_guidance_step_3: 3. Tinye eriri USB azụ, wee nwaa ọzọ.

settings_reminders_tracked: A ga-ama gị ọkwa mgbe mwepụta ọhụrụ pụtara maka sọftụwia ị rụnyere na {ngwaọrụ}. Esochiri ugbu a: {software}
settings_method_desc: Kedu ka esi ede firmware na ọkpọ gị. SP Flash Tool's console-mode XML eruba bụ usoro akwadoro na Windows na Linux; MacOS na-eji MTKClient.
flash_method_note_mtk_mac: Ụdị macOS emepụtara: na-agba ọsọ Mac na igwe a - MTKClient bụ naanị azụ azụ na ihe ngosi macOS akọwapụtara. Maka ule naanị; ngwa malitegharịa ka itinye.
simulated_mac_body_mediatek: MTKClient na-aghọ naanị usoro ịwụnye yana egosipụtara mkpali akọwapụtara nke macOS. MediaTek Installer kwesịrị ịmalitegharịa iji tinye nke a.
simulated_mac_body: MTKClient na-aghọ naanị usoro ịwụnye yana egosipụtara mkpali akọwapụtara nke macOS. Updater CE kwesịrị ịmalitegharị iji tinye nke a.

install_power_on_steps_fmt: Kwupu {labelụ} gị, wee jide {bọtịnụ} ruo mgbe ọ gbanyere.
install_disconnect_guidance_fmt:
Tupu ịga n'ihu, biko:

1. Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụghị ugbua, gbanyụọ gị {label}
   (Ị nwere ike iji ntụtụ ma ọ bụ mpempe akwụkwọ pịa bọtịnụ nrụpụta ma ọ bụrụ na ọ dị mkpa)

2. Ọ bụrụ na ejikọrọ, kwụpụ eriri USB na {label} gị.

Wee pịa OK wee soro ntuziaka na ihuenyo.
donate_installed_generic_fmt: Anyị etinyela ngwa ngwa na {model} gị.
sp_gui_prompt_steps_fmt:
• Ọ bụrụ na o nwebeghị, gbanyụọ {label} gị.
• Ọ bụrụ na ejikọrọ ya na USB, buru ụzọ kwupu ya.
• Na SP Flash Tool, pịa Download (ma ọ bụ Hazie All + Download dị ka mkpa).

Mgbe ahụ jikọọ eriri USB ka ịmalite ịmị ọkụ.
sel_type_help_body:
Gbalịa Ụdị Ngwanrọ Sistem mbụ.

sel_install_tooltip_generic: Wụnye ma ọ bụ weghachi ngwanro sistemu ahọpụtara na ngwaọrụ gị
linux_engine_staged_desc: Ngwa MediaTek SP Flash kwadoro yana ndakọrịta libpng12.
linux_engine_recheck_desc: Pịa Tugharia ma ọ bụ malitegharịa ntọala ka ibudata ngwugwu.
linux_usb_rules_active_desc: Iwu MediaTek na-arụ ọrụ (/etc/udev/rules.d/). Agbanyere ohere na desktọpụ.
linux_usb_grant_desc: Nye ikike otu ugboro ka ngwa ahụ nwee ike iji ngwaọrụ gị kparịta ụka.
linux_perms_ok_msg: Ikikere USB & iwu udev arụnyere nke ọma. Haziri ọrụ.
donate_rely_on_you: Anyị na-adabere na onyinye gị iji nọgide na-agba ọsọ. Nye onyinye ugbu a
flash_sp_gui_tooltip: Mepee MediaTek SP Flash Tool GUI
action_flash_complete: Flash zuru ezu! Kwupu USB wee malitegharịa.
action_recover_powercycle: Ike-ọkpụkpụ ihe ọkpụkpọ (jide ike ~ 10s), wee jikọọ ya - na-agbalịgharị...
action_wait_mtk: Na-eche ngwaọrụ MTK... Gbanyụọ ngwaọrụ wee jikọọ USB.
action_da_stall: Ngwaọrụ kwụsịrị ịzaghachi mgbe ị na-ahazi ihe nbudata. Gbanyụọ ya kpamkpam, jikọọ ọzọ, wee nwaa ọzọ.
action_detected_brom: Achọpụtara ngwaọrụ (ụdị BROM) - na-ahazi ihe nbudata...
action_detected_preloader: Achọpụtara ngwaọrụ (ụdị ebubu ụzọ) - na-ahazi ihe nbudata...
action_da_wait_back: Onye ọkpụkpọ kwụsịrị ịzaghachi mgbe ọ na-amalite ihe nbudata. Na-eche ka ọ laghachite...
action_restart_brom: Na-amalitegharị ihe ọkpụkpọ ahụ n'ụdị BROM...
log_install_writing: Wụnye na-aga n'ihu - na-ede onyonyo firmware...
log_sparse_fmt: Achọpụtara ihe onyonyo pere mpe gam akporo maka {akụkụ}, na-atụgharị n'ime usoro...
err_code_no_scatter: Enweghị faịlụ mgbasa ozi na ngwugwu
themepack_card_desc: Gụnyere isiokwu obodo mara mma, azụ azụ dị elu yana mkpụrụedemede emebere maka ngosipụta 360p.
themepack_step1_title: Kwụpụ 1: Jikọọ na ọnọdụ nchekwa USB
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Gbanyụọ ọkpụkpọ gị site na ijide bọtịnụ Ike.
2. Mgbe Rockbox akpụkpọ ụkwụ, ikwunye eriri USB na kọmputa gị.
3. Ọ bụrụ na kpaliri na ihuenyo ọkpụkpọ, kwado ọnọdụ nchekwa USB ka ngwaọrụ ahụ pụta dị ka mbanye.
themepack_step2_title: Nzọụkwụ 2: Họrọ ọ bụla nchekwa na Player
themepack_step2_desc: N'ihi na sistemụ arụmọrụ (dị ka macOS) zoo dotfiles (dị ka .rockbox) na ndabara, ị nwere ike họrọ nchekwa ọ bụla ma ọ bụ mgbọrọgwụ mbanye na ọkpụkpọ gị. Anyị ga-ahụta ma ọ bụ mepụta gị ndekọ ndekọ .rockbox ozugbo.
themepack_complete: Awụnyere mkpọ isiokwu nke ọma! Ị nwere ike ugbu a kwụpụ ọkpụkpọ gị n'enweghị nsogbu wee họrọ isiokwu dị na Rockbox (Ntọala> Ntọala isiokwu).
themepack_err_not_found: Enweghị ike ịchọta ma ọ bụ malite ndekọ ndekọ .rockbox na draịva ahọpụtara. Biko hụ na ị họrọla otu nchekwa na ọkpụkpọ gị.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Kwụpụ 1: Malitegharịa ekwentị ahụ wee jikọọ ọzọ
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Kwupu eriri USB.
2. Gbanyụọ onye ọkpụkpọ ahụ ma hapụ ya ka ọ banye n'ime Rockbox.
3. Ozugbo Rockbox na-agba ọsọ, jikọọ eriri USB, wee pịa Gaa n'ihu.
rockbox_wizard_adb_title: Kwụpụ 2: Na-achọ onye ọkpụkpọ n'elu ADB ...
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: Ngwa ahụ na-ekiri njikọ ADB (ruo sekọnd 30). Ọ bụrụ na achọtara ngwaọrụ, a na-ebufe isiokwu ma malitegharịa ihe ọkpụkpọ na-akpaghị aka. Ma ọ bụghị ya, gaa n'ihu gaa na ọnọdụ nchekwa USB.
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Enweghị ngwaọrụ ADB ahụrụ n'ime sekọnd 30; na-aga n'ihu na Ụdị Nchekwa USB.
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: Enweghị ọnụọgụ abụọ ADB dị na ngwa ahụ; na-aga n'ihu na Ụdị Nchekwa USB.
rockbox_wizard_adb_pushing: Na-ebugharị gburugburu na mkpụrụedemede n'elu ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: Nyefe ADB dara; na-adaghachi na ọnọdụ nchekwa USB
rockbox_wizard_usb_title: Wụnye site na ọnọdụ nchekwa USB
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Kwado ọnọdụ nchekwa USB na ihe ọkpụkpọ ka ọ dị ka mbanye.
2. Họrọ ọ bụla nchekwa na player n'okpuru (.rockbox, Music, Themes, ma ọ bụ mbanye mgbọrọgwụ - a zoro ezo .rockbox nchekwa na-akpaghị aka).
3. Ngwa ahụ jikọtara isiokwu 360p na mkpụrụedemede na, na-edegharị faịlụ otu aha.
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Ị nwere ike kwụpụ ihe ọkpụkpọ ahụ n'enweghị nsogbu wee họrọ isiokwu na Rockbox (Ntọala> Ntọala isiokwu).
legacy_cleanup_desc: Ụdị Updater ochie ka dị na kọmpụta a ma buru ohere diski. Iwepu ya na-ahapụ ohere ahụ.
legacy_cleanup_reclaim: Na-eweghachite ihe ruru {size} nke ohere diski
legacy_cleanup_remove_app_cb: Wepu ngwa Innioasis Updater ochie yana nchekwa nkwado
legacy_cleanup_keep_platform_tools_cb: Debe ngwaọrụ gam akporo Platform (ADB / Fastboot).
legacy_cleanup_platform_tools_hint: Ọ bụrụ na ị naghị eji ADB ma ọ bụ Fastboot n'èzí Updater CE, wepụ ya iji wepụ ma nwetaghachi nchekwa ọzọ.
legacy_cleanup_done_msg: Ejiri nke ọma hichaa nrụnye ihe nketa yana ohere diski eweghachitere.
legacy_cleanup_card_desc: Ụdị Updater ochie ka dị na kọmpụta a. Iwepụ ya na-ahapụ ohere diski.
legacy_cleanup_confirm_body: Nke a na-ewepụ ngwa ochie na faịlụ nkwado ya. A na-edowe ngwa ngwa ebudatara.
legacy_cleanup_tools_body: Wepu ngwaọrụ gam akporo Platform (ADB / Fastboot)? Họrọ Nọgide ma ọ bụrụ na ị na-eji ADB.
